description: 25 fixed ten-episode sequences for the two-agent protocol. Each repNNN_sampled_manifest.json is a list of 10 pairs of task ids and nothing else. The tasks live in the pool manifests under task/, and the runner resolves those ids at load time. Pass this directory as --task-sequence-record. These are rep001-rep025 of task/task_sequences_50x10, copied unchanged.
invariants: no task appears twice in a run
no code clean/buggy twin pair appears in a run (one task per spec_key)
all three task types appear in every run
every task id of a run resolves in the pool manifests under task/
file_format: {"pairs": [{"tasks": [task_id, task_id]}, ...]}, one entry per episode, in run order. No language: every code task ships a single variant, so the language is read off the pool entry rather than chosen and recorded.
